title: ReplayCompletedPayload
description: Payload of the ReplayCompleted platform event (INV-REQ-1226 b1-b2, coordinator rulings INV-Q-3644 and INV-Q-3674; class: platform), the completion marker a producer writes last on the pair's replay topic (owner ruling INV-Q-3599 A, INV-API-3655). The producing service is the CloudEvents source. Authored by INV-T-3634. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4).

replayId.description: The replayId of the ReplayRequested this marker answers.

eventsReplayed.description: How many events this producer re-emitted for the replay; 0 for an empty scope (INV-Q-3644).
